title: query --text --near
summary: Keeps only text hits in routines within N call-graph hops of a symbol
intro: Read this when a message or constant matches in many places and you only care about the ones near the code you are changing. It restricts a query --text search to routines within 1 to 3 call-graph hops of a seed symbol.
pitfalls: The default RESTRICTS: a hit outside N hops is dropped, not demoted; --near-boost keeps it.
A hop is one resolved call edge, callers and callees; --hops 4 is refused (use impact --depth).

questions.ask: Which hits of this message are near the routine I am changing?
How do I rank by nearness instead of filtering?
